relations.subject: Toni Schmid
relations.evidence: School and studies in Vienna, one year (1921) in Sweden. Dr.ph. 1922 Vienna (history and church history).

relations.subject: Toni Schmid
relations.evidence: continued studies from 1925 at Lund and from 1929 worked in Swedish national archives cataloguing medieval manuscript fragments. Fil.dr. 1931 Lund.

relations.subject: Toni Schmid
relations.evidence: In 1944-68 eo. Antikvarie in Vitterhetsakademie, then retired, but continued research.

relations.subject: Toni Schmid
relations.evidence: in the 1940s she studied under H. Smith at Uppsala
